\section*{Auction}
\begin{itemize}
\item Choose
\begin{itemize}
\item Unissued share you control
\item Share in the bank pool
\end{itemize}
\item Minimum bid = total company network value
\item In clockwise order, raise or pass (no re-entry)
\item Winner receives issued share
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection*{Winning Bid}
\begin{itemize}
\item Unissued share → Winning bid to company treasury
\item Bank share → Winning bid to bank
\item No bids → Share to bank pool; company treasury receives share value
from bank
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection*{Act for Company}
\begin{itemize}
\item Must control share (issued or unissued)
\item All costs from company treasury
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection*{Expand Network}
\begin{itemize}
\item Build on accessible, uncontrolled hex
\begin{itemize}
\item Can only build on one type of hex on a turn
\item Total value built this turn \ensuremath{\le} number of issued shares
\end{itemize}
\item Cost: \$5 x chosen hex value
\item Place number of chips equal to hex value and company cube on top
\item If expanding to city, payout per share = hex value
\end{itemize}

\paragraph*{Lease Network}
\begin{itemize}
\item Must use shortest route
\item Cost = total value of hexes used
\item Payout per share of leased companies = leased hex(es) value
\end{itemize}

\subsubsection*{Upkeep}
\begin{itemize}
\item Pay \$1 per unissued or leveraged share from personal cash to company
\begin{itemize}
\item If unable, move one unissued share to bank pool and place share value
from bank in company treasury
\end{itemize}
\end{itemize}

\section*{Leverage Share}
\begin{itemize}
\item Rotate issued share 90° to indicate it's been leveraged and receive
from the bank cash = share value
\item Leveraged share require upkeep cost and are worth nothing at end-game
\end{itemize}

\section*{Pass}
\begin{itemize}
\item Do nothing
\end{itemize}

\section*{Game End}
\begin{itemize}
\item If all players consecutively pass, game ends immediately
\item If last share of any company is issued, play two more rounds, ending
before player who issued final share
\item Final Score is sum of
\begin{itemize}
\item Cash
\item Value of issued, non-leveraged shares
\end{itemize}
\end{itemize}
